test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements (Assertion and Reason) carefully and select the most appropriate option with respect to them.

Assertion (A): Greenland is entirely green.

Reason (R): Polar regions have snow round the year.

options.text: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is false but R is true.
Both A and R are true but R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are false.

solution:
Assertion (A): Greenland is entirely green. - This is false because Greenland is mostly white due to ice, snow and glaciers.

Reason (R): Polar regions have snow round the year. - This is true because even though it has two seasons - summer and winter, in the summer, the sun shines 24 hours a day, but it never gets high enough above the horizon to warm things up, so even summers are pretty cold. It’s dark all winter at the poles, because the sun doesn’t rise during those months of the year. The North Pole is surrounded by the Arctic Ocean. There isn’t any land here, just a group of continually shifting ice sheets. The South Pole is located on Antarctica. This area has land, but it’s completely covered with a layer of ice that’s almost three miles thick in some places.

Hence, A is false but R is true.
